title: sysid.py comments name code variables that exist nowhere (prior_w, data_w, T_prev)
claim: Two comment units in sysid.py cite names no tracked code defines: '``T_prev`` sits on BOTH sides of the regression' (line 1983) and 'prior_rel = prior_w / data_w' (line 2071), while the code beneath computes prior_rel = s_noise / prior_sd and reads the previous sample as usable[i - 1].room_temp.
mechanism: The comments describe the estimator in notation from an earlier formulation; the variables were renamed or never existed, and the formula line reads as code next to a real assignment to prior_rel.
